resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives an L-5 10 by 10 foot groundhouse, and the firelookout.com page gives a 10 by 10 foot cab. The Forest Lookouts page gives a two-story 12 by 12 log cabin. The sources conflict and the story reports both. All four agree the cab was built in 1934.

The register places the lookout in the Salmon-Challis National Forest, and firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say Salmon National Forest. A 1945 survey note on the Forest Lookouts page places a 'Bear Creek Pt.' lookout tower and cabin in the Nez Perce National Forest near Red River Ranger Station. That does not match this site, so it likely describes a different point with the same name. Agency is U.S. Forest Service in every source.
The register describes a groundhouse, not a tower. The 1945 survey note mentions a lookout tower and cabin, but that note may describe a different point. No source gives a height for this cab.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1934) and the abandonment decade (1950s) agree across four sources. Sizes and national forest disagree, and the 1945 survey note on the Forest Lookouts page may describe a different Bear Creek Point. The brief's height_m of 3.0 is not supported by any source read, so it is left out of facts. No notable fires were found. A reader comment on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page about a 1956 lookout with a different roof number is not this site and is not used. Current condition and access in 2026 are unverified: sources say trail-only but give no open or closed status, so access.level is unset. The brief's access 'unknown' should stay unknown.
